rubric: S3 is one coherent scene; S0 is independent repeated tile-local scenes

SQUARE_MULTI_OBJECT.observations: Selected output has exactly one car, one central tree, one house, and one ground/horizon. The control repeats the complete object set across rows and columns.

PORTRAIT_ASTRONAUT.observations: Selected output has one centered continuous astronaut and one desert/horizon. The control contains a field of independent astronauts and repeated horizons.

LANDSCAPE_BRIDGE.observations: Selected output has one dominant continuous bridge system over one water/horizon scene. The control contains multiple independent bridge systems in repeated rows.
